content:
Common terms must satisfy
\[
10\cdot 2^{k-1}\equiv 2 \pmod 3.
\]
Since \(10\equiv 1\) and \(2\equiv -1 \pmod 3\),
\[
(-1)^{k-1}\equiv -1 \pmod 3,
\]
so \(k-1\) is odd, meaning \(k\) is even.

Thus the common terms are the GP terms with even index:
\[
10\cdot 2^{2j-1}=20\cdot 4^{j-1},\quad j=1,2,3,\ldots
\]
The first 10 are
\[
20,80,320,\ldots,20\cdot 4^9.
\]
Their sum is
\[
20(1+4+4^2+\cdots+4^9)
=20\cdot \frac{4^{10}-1}{4-1}
=20\cdot \frac{1048576-1}{3}
=6,990,500.
\]
\[
\boxed{6,990,500}
\]
